manual_image_review.note: All crops were inspected together. The wide and portrait crops visibly emphasize the square; each collection preview depicts its actual member. Historic photos are dated and do not imply current routines or identify individuals.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Ten content and geodata sources plus five inspectable image source pages; dates, roles and evidential limits are explicit.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, nine milestones, six terms, four Stories, four reading tracks and an 8×7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: Place/building/park, security/ceremony, symbol/authority, tradition/immutability and observation/opinion are distinguished.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, manifests, local assets, Politics gate report, v4.2 packet, runtime build and permanent test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: No current-holder dependency, changing schedule claim, person-tracking task or security-detail prompt; field tasks stay in public areas.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, source registry, image provenance, candidate holdbacks and rejected overclaims form a reproducible audit trail.
